**Summary**

This is an example for the simplification of the widget renderer (see: #2473).

comments.body:
Deploy preview ready!

Built with commit f76ea2653f9e7e273f03d6762a97f607af0f9374

https://deploy-preview-2472--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com

I think it could really simplifies thinking about the code in the widgets. It works for me because the connect(renderer) that we use will be hidden which is what we want because we have some plumbing that we want to hide (renderState). Let's iterate on that.

Imho that's a great improvement over the current pattern for implementing widget in InstantSearch.js. We should definetely move forward with it. However this is not high priority as we haven't identified a bug with the current approach. Are you ok @samouss for moving that to 2018?
I agree with @bobylito it would be great to don't move the connectors API until we have a v1 of angular-instantsearch 👍
@bobylito No problem, it was just a proposition. I close the PR but I leave the issue open for later.

> @bobylito No problem, it was just a proposition. I close the PR but I leave the issue open for later.

And just to be perfectly clear: I love it :)
